title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（加藤樹里研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Kato Juri)
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn how to design and carry out their own projects.
(2) acquire knowledge and learn methods of studying human cognition, emotion, consumer behavior and behavior from the perspective of social and cognitive psychology.
advice:
Students should attend weekly seminars and report on the progress of their own project.
They should engage in discussion, modify their experimental plan,
carry out their experiment, analysis their data, make a presentation, and write their report.
We will cover the topics of emotion (especially being moved) and social psychology as themes of projects.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of knowledge and skills from all lectures.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain functions of the mind from the perspective of psychology.
Ability to formulate a hypothesis about the function of the mind and propose an experimental design.
Ability to implement your own project and apply your own knowledge.

              Students will:
(1) learn how to design and carry out their own projects.
(2) acquire knowledge and learn methods of studying human cognition, emotion, consumer behavior and behavior from the perspective of social and cognitive psychology.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              Students should attend weekly seminars and report on the progress of their own project.
They should engage in discussion, modify their experimental plan,
carry out their experiment, analysis their data, make a presentation, and write their report.
We will cover the topics of emotion (especially being moved) and social psychology as themes of projects.
